meta.prompt: Using Denodo view admin.pg_vessel_positions_select, retrieve the single earliest AIS row for IMO 9293155 on UTC calendar date 2025-09-03, timestamp_date >= '2025-09-03 00:00:00' and timestamp_date < '2025-09-04 00:00:00'. Include vesselname, imonumber, mmsinumber, timestamp_date, latitudedegrees, longitudedegrees, speed, course, heading. Sort by timestamp_date ascending. Limit 1.
